w: Queensland runs its whole government out of a single chamber -- the Legislative Assembly meets here, with no second house to check it. Wedged into Gardens Point in the CBD, next to the City Botanic Gardens and Queensland University of Technology, it was heritage-listed in October 1992.
s: Queensland's one and only parliamentary chamber
_facts: Meeting place of the Parliament of Queensland; houses its only chamber, the Legislative Assembly
Located at the corner of George Street and Alice Street, Gardens Point, CBD
Next to Queensland University of Technology and the City Botanic Gardens
Listed on the Queensland Heritage Register on 21 October 1992
